package.name: qodo
package.description: Qodo code intelligence, review, and organizational standards for local coding agents.

skills.name: qodo-setup
skills.shortDescription: Connect the Qodo runtime and verify this agent is ready.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-setup to connect my Qodo account and verify this coding agent.

skills.name: qodo-codebase-wisdom
skills.shortDescription: Understand code, history, and cross-repo impact.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-codebase-wisdom to explain how this code works and cite the evidence.

skills.name: qodo-get-rules
skills.shortDescription: Load the standards that apply to the current change.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-get-rules to load the Qodo standards relevant to this task.

skills.name: qodo-manage-standards
skills.shortDescription: Create and maintain Qodo Review Standards.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-manage-standards to capture this convention as a Qodo standard.

skills.name: qodo-review
skills.shortDescription: Review local changes before opening a pull request.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-review to review my local changes before I push them.

skills.name: qodo-review-resolver
skills.shortDescription: Read and resolve Qodo pull-request findings.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-review-resolver to show me the current Qodo review findings.
